Cuttlefish.title: I spent $1,000,000 on an alien ballsack and all I got was this lousy title

posts.author: Parky
posts.title: No more PHX
posts.edited: Last Edit: August 11, 2009, 06:56:15 PM by Parky
posts.html:
I suggest that Phoenix props be removed from the server. I have a number of reasons why -

First and foremost, large, white or metal blocks are not only ugly, but extremely un-RPish. Bases should have perimeter fences etc. not huge metal barriers.

Secondly, not only do they irritate people who don't have PHX, but I have, on a number of occasions, found that spawning certain PHX props can lag, or sometimes even crash, the entire server. (A small group of admins are currently investigating this.)

To be honest, I'm mainly suggesting that it be removed due to the fact that the server, as everybody knows, and not including pay-day, lags a LOT, and I'm one of the crowd who believes that PHX is one of the main causes. I would just be happy if it was taken off for a week or so as a trial to see if it sorted some of the lag out.

But anyway, your thoughts?


Edit: Adding to what I said, what are teh uses of PHX these days anyway? The best bases are made from combine walls now. And on top of that, 90% of the bases using PHX are using the stupid tunnel props to force raiders through impossibly small spaces, in which they are extremely vulnerable to attack - this being something that the Super Admins have identified as a very mingey, and possibly bannable offence...
